This image update for google/sles-16-0-byos-v20260810-arm64 contains the following changes:
Package google-guest-configs was updated:

- Update to version 20260729.00 (bsc#1273385)  * set_multiqueue: extend x4-specific configs to future x series

- Update to version 20260707.00
  * add nic naming support for CX-9 with VR200
- from version 20260623.00
  * Avoid eval in google-dhclient-script
- from version 20260617.00
  * Enable SR-IOV for specific Intel PCI devices.
- from version 20260521.00
  * Set max queue count for IDPF devices; remove broken virtio logic

- Update to version 20260428.00
  * gce-nic-naming: optimize runtime performance
- from version 20260401.00
  * set_multiqueue: Consider c4n a "multinic accelerator"

- Update to version 20260306.00
  * gce-nic-naming: fix divide-by-zero error
- from version 20260305.00
  * set_multiqueue: detect IRDMA devices using their `infiniband/` directory
- from version 20260303.00
  * set_multiqueue: Special tunes for x4 machine family
- from version 20260223.00
  * gce-nic-naming: restore fallback to hardcoded `ip` paths
- from version 20260121.00
  * set_multiqueue: set a4x-max ring len before irq affinity

Package google-sdk-container was updated:

Package rsyslog was updated:

- added a devel subpackage, with requires (bsc#1264721)
- fix rsyslog mmpstrucdata stack overflow (bsc#1272414)
  (CVE-2026-61548)
  * add 0001-rsyslogd-fix-rsyslog-mmpstrucdata-stack-overflow.patch

- fix imptcp regex-framing remote denial of service (bsc#1271910)
  * add 0001-imptcp-guard-regex-framing-match-at-line-start.patch
